name: Solitaire MR
summary:
**Solitaire MR brings the world's best-known solitaire into your real space.**

Put on your headset: a green card table appears in front of you, in your living room, your garden or on the beach, and the cards deal themselves. Your world stays visible all around you thanks to Meta Quest passthrough.

**Play naturally**
- Tap a card and it jumps to the right spot; tap the deck to draw
- Use your hands (touch, or pinch with the ray) or the controllers (trigger)
- Grab the golden handles to move and rotate the
